# External image references

This directory is reserved for **third-party product/listing images** used as comparative evidence in XGO archaeology.

These files are not part of the immutable `images/inbox/` corpus of user-supplied photographs. Every archived retail/listing image should record:

- original source URL and retailer/site;
- retrieval date;
- page/listing identifier when available;
- what is directly visible in the image;
- whether the image is believed to depict the exact XGO A10 specimen or a closely related retail variant;
- copyright/provenance note: image remains the property of its original publisher/rights holder and is archived only as research/reference evidence.

Do not treat marketing text printed into a product image as independent hardware proof. Cross-check against the physical specimen, firmware, PCB evidence, or multiple independent listings.
